verdict.rationale: Datadog's own docs say users can query infrastructure resources and telemetry data in natural language, so the product itself accepts natural-language input. That evidence covers only querying, in a single index-level line, not broader operation of the product. The MCP server and the coding-agent setup prompt belong to other stories and are not credited here. Missing for 10: natural-language commands for operating the product (creating or changing monitors, dashboards, configuration), in-depth first-party docs on the natural-language interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Query infrastructure resources and telemetry data using natural language or DDSQL syntax with support for tags as table columns.
